item.kami.awakened_ichorweave_hood: Ichorweave Hood of the Abyssal Depths
item.kami.awakened_ichorweave_leggings: Ichorweave Leggings of the Burning Mantle
item.kami.ichorium_caster: Ichorium Caster's Gauntlet of the Ascended
Interestingly, I have discovered that harvesting any block with an awakened ichorium tool will cause any drops to appear at my feet.
While not very useful when harvesting single blocks, this effect will ensure that there is a much smaller chance of harvested materials being destroyed by falling into lava or the void when harvesting large areas.
kami.research.awakened_ichorium_axe.stag:
With how readily Ichorium seems to accept aspects, I figure there must be a way to further empower the axe.
Perhaps a heavy infusion of natural aspects will yield some result?

This new axe, which I have named the Stormbreaker, is a truly fascinating tool.
The amount of Herba essentia infused into the axe when it was created indicated some affiliation with plants, and that proved to be true.
The axe is capable of chopping down entire trees with a single swing, even harvesting entire greatwood trees in seconds. Sneaking disables this power, allowing me to harvest single blocks at a time.
Additionally, the axe shows a strange connection to the user. I once slipped and dropped the axe, yet no sooner had it impacted the ground than it bounced back into my hand.
Upon testing, I found that throwing the axe appears to imbue it with power, traveling a short distance returning to my hand.
I can cycle through the different impact effects by sneaking and interacting with the axe. The powers I have found are catalogued on the following pages.Impact: Damaging
Deals weapon damage when striking an enemy.Impact: Thundering
Summons a bolt of lighting when striking an enemy or the ground.Impact: Detonation
Spawns a small explosion that does not damage terrain when striking an enemy or the ground.
Explosion strength increases with higher throw velocity.Impact: Explosion
Spawns a large explosion that damages terrain when colliding with an enemy or the ground.
Explosion strength increases with higher throw velocity.
kami.research.awakened_ichorium_mallet.s:
A hammer the size of a doorframe wants to fall. That is all it wants.
I see no reason to refuse it - only to make the fall mean something.

The awakened ichorium mallet, which I have named the Avalanche, offers a triple attunement cycling with sneak + right-click.<PAGE>Shock<DIV>The mallet behaves like a monstrous mace: heavy, airborne and merciless on the smash-attack.<PAGE>Aftershock<DIV>Each smash attack detonates a shockwave around the point of impact, tossing and wounding surrounding enemies in the process.<PAGE>Avalanche<DIV>A smash attack against a target standing at full health brings the entire mountain down, dealing a devastating share of their maximum health.
After journeying so far into the depths of the arcane, surely the answer isn't as simple as it seems?
If ichorium tools are capable of achieving an "awakening" under the right circumstances, perhaps the best choice is to infuse the tool with the aspect it is normally associated with.

The awakened ichorium pickaxe can only be described as the tunneler's dream.
Capable of harvesting massive areas of stone simultaneously, it is truly a marvel.
Sneaking and right-clicking while holding the tool allows me to cycle through the harvest area levels.
Holding right-click empowers the pickaxe, which, upon release, will dig a tunnel in the direction I am facing.
kami.research.awakened_ichorium_shield.s:
The ichorium shield blocks as sturdily as expected, yet the metal itself seems eager to channel the force of the blows it absorbs.
Perhaps the shield does not have to merely endure an attack... perhaps it can be taught to answer one.

The awakened ichorium shield, which I have named the Warden, can be attuned between three aspects of the guard by sneak + right-clicking while holding it.<PAGE>Guard<DIV>The shield behaves as a plain, nigh-indestructible shield: sturdy, steadfast, silent.<PAGE>Reflect<DIV>Every successful block flings a portion of the blocked damage back at the attacker, as if the blow had been thrown by the shield itself.<PAGE>Barrier<DIV>A successful block becomes a heavier ward: it absorbs more incoming force, and grants me a brief surge of resistance the moment the impact lands.
kami.research.awakened_ichorium_shovel.s:
I have tried to infuse the ichorium shovel in so many ways, but none of the aspects I have found manage to bind to the tool.
It is almost as if it has a purpose unknown to me... Maybe something more morbid is the answer.

I'm not sure if I can categorize this as a success...
Empowering the shovel has allowed it to dig a larger area, but it also seems to have an unsettling affinity for burying creatures alive.
Holding right click causes the shovel to build up charge. Upon release, all entities surrounding me are instantly buried underground, where they slowly suffocate to death.
While effective, it is certainly unsettling to hear animal suffocate just below the surface. Luckily, the shovel can be attuned to only inter specific entities. The specific attunement can be cycled by sneak right clicking while holding the tool.Inter Undead
Buries all undead entities surrounding the player.
Charge duration increases the interment area.Inter Animals
Buries all animals surrounding the player.
Charge duration increases the interment area.Inter Hostiles
Buries all hostile entities surrounding the player.
Charge duration increases the interment area.Inter All
Buries all creatures surrounding the player.
Charge duration increases the interment area.
kami.research.awakened_ichorium_spear.st:
Of all the ichorium implements, the spear is the one that craves motion. Its shaft trembles with held-back momentum whenever I charge a thrust.
If momentum can be stored, then perhaps it can be spent - spent faster than any mage can finish an incantation.

The awakened ichorium spear, which I have named the Spellbreaker, carries a triple attunement cycling with sneak + right-click.<PAGE>Thrust<DIV>The spear behaves as a plain kinetic spear, ready for charging into a piercing stab.<PAGE>Spellbreak<DIV>Every strike, charged or not, is infused with a disruptive essence that deals additional damage to anything it reaches - mundane or therwise.<PAGE>Lunge<DIV>Right-clicking spends the spear's stored momentum in an instant dash, cutting through spear-length of space and wounding everything in its path before cooling down.
kami.research.awakened_ichorium_spear.ti: Magic is merely cheating with extra steps
kami.research.awakened_ichorium_sword.st:
The ichorium sword is almost too mundane considering its cost. I would have expected such a legendary weapon to be sharper at the very least.
Perhaps it's not the weapon I should focus on, but rather the entity being struck...

The awakened ichorium sword, which I have named the titanslayer, has the unique ability to attune itself to specific enemy types, granting bonuses when striking attuned enemies.Unattuned
When not attuned, the awakened sword foregoes any entity attunement bonus.
Instead all energy within the sword is channeled into the blade, doubling the base damage of the weapon.Mortal's Bane
A bane to all living creatures, when attuned to mortals, the awakened sword bypasses all armor and deals up to 20% of a living entity's maximum hp on every hit.Undead Slayer
Some might call it a holy sword, but I know better.
When attuned to undeath, the awakened sword bypasses all armor and deals up to 20% of an undead target's maximum health.Dragonslayer
Legends speak of the greatest warriors who ever lived slaying mighty dragons. While I may not be able to achieve their level of notoriety, the awakened sword can get me close to achieving their feats.
When attuned to dragons, the awakened sword bypasses all armor and deals up to 20% of a dragon's maximum health.
Interestingly, this effect also appears to extend to entities wearing dragon-based armor.Abomination Slayer
During my studies I have encountered entities that do not fit into any standard categories.
These creatures seem to either be otherworldly Eldritch beings, or Tainted abominations that revel in high-flux environments.
When attuned to abominations, the awakened sword bypasses the armor of tainted or eldritch creatures and deals up to 20% of the target's maximum health.
The trident accepts ichorium the way the sea accepts the horizon: eagerly, and without complaint.
It is not enough for the trident to merely return to my hand... it should also drag the storm home with it.

The awakened ichorium trident, which I have named the Stormcaller, cycles its attunements with sneak + right-click.<PAGE>Throw<DIV>The trident is hurled and returns to my hand after a short flight, as any loyal weapon should.<PAGE>Thunder<DIV>Wherever the stormcaller strikes, the sky answers: a bolt of lightning is summoned at the point of impact.<PAGE>Tide<DIV>The trident never leaves my hand. Charging it instead surges me forward on a riptide tide, crashing through enemies with a spinning strike - no water or rain required. A Riptide enchantment lends the surge extra force.
kami.research.awakened_ichorweave.addend:
It appears that awakened ichorweave equipment has a resonance that only occurs when worn by a living creature.
When equipped with a full set of awakened ichorweave armor, all damage taken is reduced by 80%. It is also still fully dyeable like normal ichorweave armor.
Closer examination reveals that Ichor is unlike any material I have encountered, almost as though it is asleep...
I wonder what would occur if I managed to awaken or empower ichorweave armor?

While I admit I was expecting more, I certainly cannot complain with the results.
When awakened, the ichorweave boots grant the wearer increased movement speed and jump height, similar to the effects granted by the boots of the traveler.
Additionally, the boots grant immunity to slowness effects.
While the effects are relatively mundane, it certainly is nice to no longer have to worry about constantly recharging my boots.
kami.research.awakened_ichorweave_hood.s:
Closer examination reveals that Ichor is unlike any material I have encountered, almost as though it is asleep...
I wonder what would occur if I managed to awaken or empower ichorweave armor?

Awakened with tenebrae, it's no suprise the awakened ichorweave hood has an affinity for the depths of the world.
When equipped, the awakened ichorweave hood grants the wearer infinite underwater breathing and night vision.
kami.research.awakened_ichorweave_hood.t: Ichorweave Hood of the Abyssal Depths
kami.research.awakened_ichorweave_leggin:
Closer examination reveals that Ichor is unlike any material I have encountered, almost as though it is asleep...
I wonder what would occur if I managed to awaken or empower ichorweave armor?

Though the amount of ignis involved in the process of awakening the ichorweave leggings was a bit concerning, I cannot argue with the results.
When equipped, The awakened ichorweave leggings grants the wearer immunity to environmental hazards such as fire, lava, poison and wither.
They also grant the ability to double jump. However, the double jumping ability interferes with the same effect from the Cloudstepper Ring.
Ichorweave Leggings of the Burning Mantle
kami.research.awakened_ichorweave_robe.s:
Closer examination reveals that Ichor is unlike any material I have encountered, almost as though it is asleep...
I wonder what would occur if I managed to awaken or empower ichorweave armor?

The Ichorweave Robes have a a strong affinity for the air, similar to what I have experienced with an elytra.
Unlike an elytra, these robes grant unrestricted flight as well as totally negating fall damage.
kami.research.bottomless_pouch.stage.1:
I have noticed a very strange phenomenon that occurs when two pieces of ichorcloth are stacked on top of one another.
Upon lifing the edge of the top cloth, I discovered an empty pocket of air between the two pieces of fabric.
While that might not sound impressive, it wasn't until I was able to insert my entire arm into the space that I truly discovered how large it was.
kami.research.bottomless_pouch.stage.2:
The success of my experiment is slightly concerning. While I had originally thought that there might be a way to create something resembling a bag of holding, I did not consider just how much space would be created.
The Bottomless Pouch is a 117 slot bag that can function as a focus pouch.
kami.research.bottomless_pouch.title: Bottomless Pouch
kami.research.eternal_infusion.stage.1:
Ichor is such a strange substance. It is malleable enough to be worked into tools and armor relatively easily, yet the moment it takes its final shape it is nearly impossible to alter.
Perhaps there is a way to imbue its properties into other tools. Even a thin coating would significantly improve a tool's durability.
kami.research.eternal_infusion.stage.2:
I can only describe what I have achieved as incredible.
I set out to increase the durability of my tools, but instead I have found a way to make them completely invulnerable to damage.
Taking what I know from infusion enchantments, I have managed to bind ichor to damagable items almost perfectly. Not only do the infused items retain their original properties, they also become completely unbreakable.
kami.research.eternal_infusion.title: Infusion Enchantment: Eternal
kami.research.ichor.stage.1:
All of my experiments into have, up to this point, resulted in relatively mundane materials.
I feel as though there must be a way to go a step further, making a material that transcends physical limitations.
kami.research.ichor.stage.2:
Through extensive study in all subjects of thaumaturgy I have discovered a substance that can be considered to be the next step in my endeavours. I have melded some of the most powerful materials together with primordial energy to create this substance.
This extremely powerful substance, which I am calling "Ichor" contains an unimaginable amount of raw awakened power.
I am sure I will be able to put it to use for countless devices in the future.
kami.research.ichor.title: Ichor
kami.research.ichor.title.subtitle: Blood of the Gods
kami.research.ichorium.stage.1:
Experimentation has shown that Ichor is capable of bonding to most metals, but the results are useless to a degree that surprised even me.
However, materials that are otherworldy, for lack of a better term, are almost drawn to one another.
While they mix about as well as water and oil, infusion may provide the key to transforming them into a homogeneous material.
kami.research.ichorium.stage.2:
I have managed to blend Ichor with void metal to create an entirely new material with completely unique properties.
It is completely impervious to corrosion or damage, yet it is almost as malleable as clay.
I haven't found any uses for it yet, but I know it shouldn't take me too long.
kami.research.ichorium.title: Ichorium
kami.research.ichorium.title.subtitle: A metal harder than diamond
kami.research.ichorium_caster.addenda.1: Not only does the ichorium gauntlet have better resonance with the local aura, it also appears to be much more malleable than other materials, accepting up to five augments compared to the three of its thaumium or void counterparts.
kami.research.ichorium_caster.stage.1: With how successful my other experiments with ichor have been, I cannot help but wonder what would happen if I applied the material to a caster's gauntlet.
kami.research.ichorium_caster.stage.2:
Yet again my expectations have been shattered.
Ichor has proven to be an incredible focus material. Spells channeled through the gauntlet have their vis costs reduced by 30%, not including any bonuses from equipment, and any remaining vis drain is distributed in a 5x5 chunk area centered on me.
If I so choose, I can dye the gauntlet with any of the dye combinations I want.
kami.research.ichorium_caster.title: Ichorium Caster's Gauntlet of the Ascended
kami.research.ichorium_caster.title.subt: "I could simply snap my fingers and they would all cease to exist."
kami.research.ichorium_tools.stage.1: Normally I would be able to create equipment right away with most other materials, Ichor-based materials however, will require some additional trial and error in order to successfully achieve this.
kami.research.ichorium_tools.stage.2: I now have the ability to construct Ichorium tools. These tools are so powerful that it is impossible for them to break.
kami.research.ichorium_tools.title: Ichorium Tools
kami.research.ichorweave_armor.stage.1: Normally I would be able to create equipment right away with most other materials, Ichor-based materials however, will require some additional trial and error in order to successfully achieve this.
kami.research.ichorweave_armor.stage.2:
I now have the ability to construct the Ichorweave set. The armor set is so powerful that it is impossible for any of the pieces to break, I can also get a decent amount of vis discount out of them.
If I so choose, I can dye the armor with any of the dye combinations I want.
kami.research.ichorweave_armor.title: Ichorweave Armor
kami.research.ichorweave_fabric.stage.1: Ichor shows a strong reaction towards cloth. If done correctly, I should be able to create the perfect fabric.
kami.research.ichorweave_fabric.stage.2: I now am able to upgrade basic magical fabric into a special ichorweave fabric. It is immune to tearing and it is oddly flexible, imagine the possibilities!
kami.research.ichorweave_fabric.title: Ichorweave Fabric
kami.research.ichorweave_fabric.title.su: Hope you brought a strong needle
kami.research.zenith_base.stage.1: This might be my magnum opus. I have the potential to reach beyond anything I could ever imagine, and perhaps... become a god myself.
kami.research.zenith_base.title: Zenith
kami.research.zenith_base.title.subtitle: The highest point
